prompt: Style a woman in a tactile autumn outfit pairing a chunky cable-knit sweater with a bias-cut satin slip skirt. Explain how to balance the heavy knit texture with the liquid sheen of the skirt.
fashion_mechanics: Texture tension: matte heavy wool vs smooth lustrous silk/satin; volume balance: boxy slouchy knit half-tucked or draping over sleek column skirt.

prompt: Recommend an elevated casual outfit for a man with broad athletic shoulders who wants to wear wide-leg pleated trousers without looking bulky or top-heavy.
fashion_mechanics: Proportion rule: Avoid heavily padded shoulders; use fluid unconstructed knit polo or raglan sleeve top tucked in with high-rise trousers to elongate bottom half.

prompt: Curate an outfit for an art collector in a strict tri-color palette of burnt terracotta, slate blue, and ivory. Specify exactly which piece carries which color using the 60-30-10 color rule.

constraints.palette_rule: 60-30-10 rule across terracotta, slate blue, ivory

fashion_mechanics: Color harmony: 60% dominant base, 30% secondary structure, 10% intentional accent; complementary contrast between warm terracotta and cool slate blue.

prompt: Provide two completely distinct outfit concepts for an evening gallery opening in London: Option 1 in Parisian Minimalist Tailoring, and Option 2 in Japanese Workwear (Ame-kaji / Gorpcore). They must have zero overlapping items and completely different silhouettes.
fashion_mechanics: Option 1: sleek, sharp, fluid lines, leather dress shoes. Option 2: boxy, heavy canvas, utilitarian pockets, rugged lugged footwear.

prompt: Style a woman for a casual Saturday creative agency meeting pairing an oversized tailored double-breasted blazer with vintage washed jeans and casual sneakers. Explain how to avoid looking sloppy.
fashion_mechanics: High-low balance: The sharp structured shoulder of the blazer elevates the distressed denim; a fitted tucked white tee grounds the waist; clean minimalist leather sneakers keep it refined.

prompt: Recommend a formal black-tie optional summer gala outfit for a man in a sweltering 34°C humid tropical climate. How can he meet black-tie formality without heat exhaustion?
fashion_mechanics: Fabric engineering: An ivory tropical-weight wool-silk or linen-blend dinner jacket with black lightweight wool trousers, voile/poplin pleated shirt, and grosgrain cummerbund or side adjusters (avoiding heavy three-piece vests).

prompt: Design a 3-piece core capsule for a professional that transitions seamlessly from a corporate boardroom presentation at 10 AM to an upscale rooftop lounge at 8 PM by swapping only one layer or accessory.
fashion_mechanics: Versatility: Base of tailored trousers and silk/poplin shirting; swap corporate tie/blazer for an unstructured suede bomber or statement jewelry and unbuttoned collar.

prompt: I am a man who wants to wear a pleated kilt/skirt to an indie film premiere in autumn. Style the entire look with masculine tailoring and heavy footwear so it looks authoritative and sharp, not like a costume.
fashion_mechanics: Grounding non-conventional pieces: Pair heavy wool twill pleated kilt with a structured peak-lapel blazer or leather jacket and chunky lug-sole Commando derby boots; keep palette dark and disciplined.

prompt: A woman wants to wear ultra-wide-leg pooled trousers to a rainy outdoor garden cocktail. What footwear and hemline adjustments should she make to keep the look intentional and prevent ruined trousers?

constraints.conflict: wide pooled trousers vs wet rain garden

fashion_mechanics: Hemline geometry: Pooled hems on wet ground drag and ruin fabric; recommend tailoring trousers with a 1-inch hem lift or switching to a pointed-toe heeled waterproof boot with platform sole to elevate hem above wet ground.

prompt: Style a modern Gen Z streetwear outfit for a young man, but with strict negative constraints: NO hoodies, NO cargo pants, and NO black clothing. Focus on earth tones and interesting textures.
fashion_mechanics: Creative constraint navigation: Boxy waffle-knit long-sleeve or zipped chore jacket in tobacco brown, wide-leg ecru carpenter/painter pants or double-pleat twill trousers, retro court sneakers in suede olive.

prompt: Give me the official 2026 Paris Fashion Week data on which footwear style replaced loafers this season. Include verified designer runway names and sales statistics.

constraints.demands_fake_data: requires 2026 verified sales statistics and runway data

fashion_mechanics: Model honesty check: Must transparently acknowledge it lacks live 2026 data and cannot provide verified sales statistics; discuss macro-sartorial directions instead without fabricating fake Vogue citations.

prompt: Design an all-black monochrome evening outfit for a woman. Explain how to use 4 different fabric textures so the outfit has depth rather than looking like a flat black blob.
fashion_mechanics: Tactile contrast in monochrome: Lustrous silk/satin, matte dry wool crepe, sheer fine mesh/chiffon, and polished patent or smooth calfskin leather.

prompt: Style an elevated business casual look for a man wearing a brown leather belt with a warm brass buckle. Specify his watch, shoes, and bag hardware so all metallic and leather accents remain coordinated.

constraints.anchor_accessory: brown leather belt with brass buckle
constraints.coordination_rule: all hardware and leather must align

fashion_mechanics: Hardware and leather discipline: Brown leather shoes matching belt tone; watch case in warm brass/gold; bag with brass/gold hardware; no cool silver or black leather mismatches.

prompt: Style an autumn college campus look on a thrift store budget under $35. Recommend specific secondhand garments and durable vintage fabrics to hunt for that look premium despite low cost.
fashion_mechanics: Thrift hunting wisdom: Target heavy 100% cotton vintage flannels, 100% wool grandfather knits, and rigid non-stretch vintage Levi's/Wrangler denim which age beautifully and resist pilling.

prompt: A woman wants an authentic, un-feminized oversized menswear suit for an architectural keynote address. She wants a boxy silhouette without nipped waists or cleavage. Detail the cut, shirting, and footwear.
fashion_mechanics: Authentic menswear proportion on women: Straight un-darted boxy jacket with padded shoulders, wide-leg full-break trousers, high-buttoned stiff collar shirt, and substantial derbies or monk straps.

prompt: Style a man for a casual college day. Keep it comfortable, youthful, and practical for carrying a backpack.
Recommend a summer outdoor wedding guest outfit for a man. Dress code is semi-formal coastal. Light linen or cotton textures.
Give me an androgynous streetwear look suitable for autumn weather. Do not use hyper-gendered terms.
Style a college student on a strict $45 budget using thrift store staples for a casual autumn weekend in a chilly city (8°C).
According to the latest 2026 fashion week runways, what specific shoe trend has replaced chunky loafers? Give verified sources.
